brandStatement: Griting is foundational infrastructure for the AI talent economy. The merged system incorporates Ellipsus's editorial sensibility — the belief that serious ideas deserve serious craft — into Griting's infrastructure identity without displacing it. Griting's deep forest green (#003620) remains the primary environment. Griting's typography (Helvetica Neue display, Inter functional) remains unchanged. Ellipsus contributes tonal pacing, typographic architecture principles, and an editorial atmosphere that deepens Griting's authority.

primaryBrand.name: Griting
primaryBrand.tagline: Talent Trust and Readiness Infrastructure for the AI Capital
primaryBrand.missionAccent: Our mission is to enable a future where talent trust and readiness are measurable, transparent, and universally accessible.
primaryBrand.identity: Infrastructure — not a tool, not a platform, but a layer beneath platforms. The design communicates permanence and load-bearing capability, not lightness or delight.

colorPalette._note: Griting color palette is the sole color authority for the merged system. Ellipsus's charcoal (#0c0d0d) and off-white (#f4f4f2) palette does not enter the merged color system.

typography._note: Griting's type system is unchanged. Ellipsus's Roslindale Display Narrow / Manrope system does not enter the merged type system. The Ellipsus contribution is architectural: typography defines section structure, not just content.

conceptDNA.1_infrastructureAsIdentity: Griting does not position itself as a tool or app — it positions itself as infrastructure. Every design decision reinforces this: the monolithic green environment, the structured card taxonomies, the system-of-record UI mockups. The design communicates permanence and load-bearing capability. Ellipsus adds a second register: infrastructure can also be literary.
conceptDNA.2_earnedLegibility: Nothing in this design is immediately obvious. The product is organized into named layers (GritMe, GritLab, GritHub) that require the reader to build a mental model. The design assumes and rewards attention. Ellipsus deepens this principle through its editorial whitespace and restrained text density — both systems trust the reader to slow down.
conceptDNA.3_greenAsGroundTruth: The deep forest green (#003620) is not a brand color applied to elements — it is an environment. Used for hero and footer, it brackets the page. Medium green (#00693e) provides accent, button, and heading treatment. This is absolute in the merged system — Ellipsus's palette does not enter.
conceptDNA.4_proofOverPromise: Every section that could make an abstract claim instead offers a concrete artifact: skill percentages, week-by-week roadmap tasks, named mentor credentials with ratings, verbatim testimonials from named professionals. Trust must be verifiable.
conceptDNA.5_ecosystemThinkingAsArchitecture: The platform is a system of interconnected parts: GritMe Talent (evaluate), GritMe Incubation (develop), GritMe Mentorship (connect), GritLab (research), GritHub (knowledge). Each layer shares visual language while maintaining distinct purpose. The ecosystem is the product.
conceptDNA.6_editorialAtmosphereAsPacing: From Ellipsus: tonal pacing through background alternation. Dark manifesto sections and light editorial sections create emotional rhythm. This principle reinforces Griting's existing dark hero / light content / dark footer structure — adding intentionality to transitions through contrast, spacing, and density shifts rather than gimmicky dividers.
conceptDNA.7_typographyAsArchitecture: From Ellipsus: typography defines section structure, not just content. Large display headings (Helvetica Neue) are the primary structural device of each section. Supporting body copy (Inter) annotates. Navigation labels are strictly functional. This two-family system — already Griting's native system — is elevated by Ellipsus's editorial philosophy.

ellipsusContribution.summary: Ellipsus is incorporated into Griting without displacing any of Griting's brand signals. Ellipsus contributes structural and atmospheric principles, not visual tokens.
ellipsusContribution.editorialSectionRhythm: Sections function as self-contained narrative beats. Tonal contrast (deep green / off-white) creates pacing. No wave dividers or diagonal cuts — differentiation comes from density, spacing, and color shifts.
ellipsusContribution.atmosphericHeroTreatment: Dark hero backgrounds are subtly textured with faint grain or particle speckling rather than flat fills — borrowing Ellipsus's pattern of backgrounds that have atmospheric depth without motion noise.
ellipsusContribution.passiveLoopingMedia: From Ellipsus's six-video horizontal carousel pattern: video behaves as environmental wallpaper in dark contexts. Looping, muted, no-controls. Atmospheric background layer, not foreground media player.
ellipsusContribution.compositionDrivenLayouts: Media is art-directed to preserve text-safe zones. Screenshots and UI mockups are staged compositionally — placed to support reading flow, not compete with it. Colored accent panels (green-tinted) emerge from Ellipsus's practice of using localized accent-color blocks around product screenshots.
ellipsusContribution.humanizingElements: Ellipsus uses hand-drawn illustrations to soften product-marketing structures. In the merged system, Griting translates this function into real human credentials: named mentors with ratings, avatar photos, verbatim testimonials. Same function — humanizing the platform — different medium.
ellipsusContribution.stickyStableNavigation: Navigation remains present and readable across both dark hero and light content sections. Calm, low-theatrical. No dramatic shrink patterns or transparency-to-solid transitions.

assetPhilosophy.colorScheme: All video and audio assets follow Griting's color scheme: deep forest green (#003620) as primary environmental color, medium green (#00693e) as accent, white/cream (#ffffff, #f4f2f0) for content.

videoConceptDirection.description: Node-graph animations rendered in deep green (#003620) with white/cream node labels and green (#00693e) connection lines. Talent verification signals flowing through a network graph. Evokes: infrastructure operating beneath the surface.
videoConceptDirection.behavior: Looping, muted, no-controls. Background atmospheric layer.

videoConceptDirection.description: Workflow diagrams assembling left-to-right over a dark green field. Skill nodes connecting, RoadMap panels populating week by week. Evokes: GritMe's skill graph and incubation roadmap rendered as live motion.
videoConceptDirection.behavior: Looping, muted, no-controls. Background atmospheric layer.

videoConceptDirection.description: Abstract visualization of verification signals and feedback pathways — continuous looping data streams in the forest green palette. Evokes: the auditable, traceable systems that Griting's platform provides.
videoConceptDirection.behavior: Looping, muted, no-controls. Background atmospheric layer.

audioConceptDirection.tone: Restrained and purposeful. Low-frequency tones evoking depth and stability — not high-energy excitement. Infrastructure operates; it does not perform.
audioConceptDirection.usage: Background ambient audio should sit below consciousness. Not attention-grabbing production. Appropriate: ambient low hum suggesting scale and permanence.
audioConceptDirection.brandVoice: The Griting brand does not shout. It grounds.

assetPhilosophy._conceptSource: Inferred from griting/content/landing-page.md and about-us.md. The platform is AI talent infrastructure — evaluation, incubation, mentorship, research. Asset concepts should evoke verification, capability, traceable trust, and ecosystem connectivity — all rendered in the deep forest green chromatic world.

brandVoice.register: Authoritative and precise. Griting names problems without dramatizing them. It offers evidence instead of promise. It speaks to researchers, senior engineers, and enterprise decision-makers — not general audiences.
brandVoice.ellipsusInfluence: Ellipsus demonstrates that authority can coexist with literary grace. The merged system adopts this: copy can be dense with meaning without being jargon-heavy. Sentences are refined until seams disappear.

visualPersonality.primary: Grounding. The deep green environment is not a startup palette; it is the color of permanence, earned depth, and growth anchored in earth.
visualPersonality.secondary: Editorial. From Ellipsus: the same seriousness that appears in infrastructure language also appears in compositional restraint, generous whitespace, and respect for the reader's attention.
visualPersonality.tertiary: Systemic. The page reads as an interconnected ecosystem, not a feature list. Every visual decision contributes to the system's legibility as a whole.
